log.msg: MY EXIT CONDITION, NAMED AGAIN BEFORE WALKING - the same three, unchanged since visit five. (1) ONE RENDERER: exactly one class draws a configured page, and no second one has grown back. (2) ONE VOCABULARY, END TO END: the words a control writes are the words a file stores are the words a url says are the words a reader reads - and every one of them can be SET, SAVED and SENT by the same reader. (3) NO CONTROL WRITES A KEY NOTHING READS, AND NO RENDERER READS A KEY NOTHING WRITES, in both directions, on every page, including the pages the realm makes. Visit five: (1) true, (2) and (3) false. Visit six: (1) and (2) true, (3) false - the same defect one level deeper for the fifth round running (the seven words, then the blocks, then a nested page's children, then the eighth field). This visit tests exactly one thing: whether (3) is closed, or whether the defect moved in one more level again. If it moved in again I will say so and say what the pattern is.

THE SIXTH LIST, RE-CHECKED WITH FILE:LINE - ALL SEVEN LANDED, and one of my own sixth-visit claims turns out to have been wrong. fix1 a nested page survives being saved: blocks.js:309 EXTRAS is blocks/default/nest, config.js:340 node_for writes mode.nest, config.js:306 code_for_config prints it, stage.js:101 stage_props returns it, stage.js:183 turns the string back into a page - and url.js:128 gives a made-page url an id equal to its url, so a preset id and a page address both ride through. fix2 the default tab: stage.js:97 open = kids.findIndex(is_default), stage.js:195 base_open, build/words.js:218 prints open under its own comment. fix3 the two url controls: stage.js:488 page_at asks nest_of(url) FIRST, so a library address runs in the content box. fix4 Build's duplicates: build/page.js:213-217 is Name/Blocks/Pages only, and there is one Toolbar on the page (build/page.js:381). fix5 the docs: doc/mechanisms.md:60 and doc/templates.md:60 now name that machinery in the PAST tense, and build/readme.md no longer mentions chips(). fix6 aria-pressed: config.js:163, the twelve nest chips. fix7: kind_of() is gone, and make/made.js:143 writes the trailing newline. MY OWN CORRECTION: last visit I wrote that grep finds no axes: anywhere in the realm. That was false - blocks.js:200 and skin/page.js:24 both carry it, live and correct (Skin is the one block with three words). The stale docs were stale about chips() and dress(), not about axes:.

RENDERERS: STILL ONE, nothing dead beside it. stage.js:133 PagingStage is the only class that draws a configured page; build/stage.js:35 BuildStage is a 109-line frame that CONSTRUCTS one (build/stage.js:51) and adds the three things a builder has and a page does not - crumbs, the title, a child's panel. VOCABULARIES: STILL ONE - blocks.js:237 CONTROLS, with build/words.js:52 re-exporting rather than copying. Both hold from visit six.

THE THREE BREAKS I FOUND ARE ONE BREAK, AND ITS LEVEL IS THE DRAWER. Private server 8171, killed by pid. The sixth pass mounted the realm's own bar over Build (build/page.js:381) so that all seven words could be saved there - it worked, and the bar brought the DRAWER with it. The drawer is written for a page that IS seven words (config.js:229 node_for, config.js:301 code_for_config), and it is now hanging over two pages that are more than seven words. MEASURED ON /imagine/paging/build/ with a prose block, one tab and a nested dashboard: the drawer's box THIS PAGE, AS A FILE prints title New page, mode with nest dashboard, children [] - no blocks, no children; thirty pixels below it the column's own box THE FILE prints the same page with the blocks and the children and NO nest. Two files, one screen, neither one the page you built. The drawer's THE SAME PAGE, AS CODE prints a Paging titled Build - the page you are STANDING on, not the one you are making. And there are two save buttons: Save (the column) and Make this a page (the drawer). MEASURED ON /imagine/paging/make/notes/, a real made page with two children: the drawer's AS CODE prints this.stage({seven}) with no pages: and no children:, so the file it hands you would draw the four canned strangers instead of Today and Later - while build/words.js:219 code_for_node gets exactly that right for a node. Two printers; the lossy one is the one on the page you actually made.

AND THE SAME BREAK, TWICE MORE, PROVEN IN THE RUNNING APP WITH NO FILE WRITTEN. (a) THE NEST CONTROL ON BUILD WRITES NOTHING AND IS LOST BY THE NEXT PRESS. On /imagine/paging/build/ the drawer's twelve nest chips are present; clicking A dashboard with a left rail puts a whole dashboard in the builder's box - and the file pane, whose own line reads The node exactly as it goes to disk. It changes with every control you press, never gains a nest key, and neither does the printed page.js. One press of a LEFT-column control (Add a tab) and the nested page is GONE, with nothing said. The cause is two missing lines: build/stage.js:51 constructs its PagingStage without nest, and build/page.js:377 sets build.$stage.keep but no keep_nest - the two hooks make/page.js:108 and :124 both set. (b) THE DRAWER'S LINK ON BUILD PROMISES SOMETHING IT CANNOT KEEP. I set room=Wide and type size=Display from Build's bar; the drawer's first box handed me /imagine/paging/build/?room=wide&type-size=display under the sentence Open it cold, in any browser, and you get exactly this page. Opened cold, that address gives room reading and type regular - Build's stage is inner:true, so stage.js:169 never consults from_url. The address bar itself stayed bare the whole time.

WHAT IS HEALTHY, MEASURED. My three sixth-visit breaks are all closed live: ?content=/imagine/paging/library/blog-post/ RUNS that preset in the box; ?content=/framework/ui/ says Nothing here could be read at and names the three addresses that work; ?nest=/imagine/paging/make/notes/ on the blog-post preset draws Notes with tabs Today and Later and real child links; and the drawer on /imagine/paging/library/nest/ now carries nest in both exports. THE WHOLE REALM: 65 urls x 1280 and 3440 = 130 cold loads, ZERO page errors, ZERO sideways scroll, and the only console line is the known readme declared-child probe 404, by design. Nothing under public/ was changed; git reports public/imagine/paging clean. ONE LAYOUT DEFECT ON THE SIDE, measured because I met it: build.css:63 makes .build-centre position: sticky with no max-height, so once the middle column is taller than the window - which one nested page or a couple of blocks does - the sticky card paints OVER the boxes below it. At 3440 the column is 1617px in a 1400px window and 3 of 4 probe points along the file pane's own explanatory line hit .build-centre instead of the text.

THE THREE CONDITIONS, PLAINLY. (1) ONE RENDERER - TRUE, and nothing dead beside it. (2) ONE VOCABULARY, END TO END - TRUE ON A PAGE YOU MADE, FALSE IN THE BUILDER. Everything visit six proved still holds on /imagine/paging/make/notes/: set a word in the bar, the file says it within the second, the address stays bare, a cold reload brings it back. In Build the eighth word can be SET and can be neither SAVED nor SENT. (3) NO CONTROL WRITES A KEY NOTHING READS - STILL FALSE, sixth round running, and one level in again. The levels, in order: the seven words, then the blocks, then a nested page's children, then the eighth field on a saved page, and now THE DRAWER ITSELF. Each pass fixed the level it was shown and mounted the same control one level further in without asking what it was standing on. The sixth pass put the realm's bar over Build so all seven words could be saved there; the bar carries the drawer, and every box in the drawer that says THIS PAGE is true only of a page that IS seven words - which the twelve presets are, and which neither editor is.

FIX 1 - The drawer's two export boxes are false on both editors, and they are the boxes a reader takes away - /imagine/paging/build/ and /imagine/paging/make/notes/. config.js:229 node_for and config.js:301 code_for_config print seven words under the headings THIS PAGE, AS A FILE and THE SAME PAGE, AS CODE; on notes/ the printed page.js has no pages: and no children:, so it would draw the four canned strangers instead of Today and Later, and in Build the printed file has no blocks and no children. fill_drawer already takes the page - hand it the NODE when the page has one and let those two boxes use build/words.js:207 code_for_node and the real file, so there is one true answer per question - M

FIX 2 - The nest control in Build puts a page inside and saves nothing, and one press of any left-column control throws it away with nothing said - /imagine/paging/build/. build/stage.js:51 builds its PagingStage with no nest, and build/page.js:377 sets build.$stage.keep but no keep_nest. Two lines, and both already exist next door: pass nest: mode_of(node).nest, and set build.$stage.keep_nest = id => this.set_words({ nest: id ?? undefined }) - the twins of make/page.js:108 and :124 - S

FIX 3 - The drawer's link box promises a cold-openable address on a page that cannot read one - config.js:103 link_box, over Build's inner stage. It hands you /imagine/paging/build/?room=wide&type-size=display under the words Open it cold, in any browser, and you get exactly this page; opened cold it gives reading and regular, because stage.js:169 skips from_url on an inner stage. One line - do not draw the box when stage.inner - and the sentence stops being false - S

FIX 4 - Two Save buttons and four export boxes on one screen - /imagine/paging/build/ has Save (the column, writing the node) and Make this a page (the drawer, writing a different file), plus two file boxes and two code boxes that disagree. After fixes 1 and 2 the drawer's json_box is a second answer to a question the column already answers: skip it when the page has its own Save, so the builder has one file, one code and one Save - S

FIX 5 - The builder's middle column paints over the boxes below it - build.css:63 gives .build-centre position: sticky with no height limit, so the moment the column is taller than the window (one nested page, or a couple of blocks) the card covers what you scroll to. Measured at 3440: the column is 1617px in a 1400px window and 3 of 4 probe points along the file pane's own explanatory line land on .build-centre. A sticky column needs max-height: calc(100vh - 1em) and its own overflow - S

assign.outcome:
**(1) is true. (2) is true on a page you made and false in the builder. (3) is still false — the same defect, one level in again, and this time the level is the drawer.**

**My exit condition, unchanged since visit five.** (1) exactly one class draws a configured page; (2) the words a control writes are the words the file stores are the words the url says are the words the reader reads, and every one can be **set, saved and sent** by the same reader; (3) no control writes a key nothing reads, and no renderer reads a key nothing writes — *on every page, including the pages the realm makes*.

**All seven of my sixth list landed** — `nest` rides in `mode` (`blocks.js:309`) and both exports print it; the default tab is read on the saved page (`stage.js:97`); `page_at()` asks `nest_of()` first so the two url controls take the same pages (`stage.js:488`); Build's duplicate controls are gone; the stale docs now speak in the past tense; the nest chips announce themselves; `kind_of()` is deleted and `page.json` ends with a newline. One correction to my own last verdict: I wrote that `axes:` exists nowhere in the realm. **That was false** — `blocks.js:200` and `skin/page.js:24` both carry it, live and correct.

**Renderers: one. Vocabularies: one.** Both hold. **130 cold loads** at 1280 and 3440: zero page errors, zero sideways scroll, one known-by-design 404.

![In the builder: a whole dashboard running inside the box, and directly under it the file that says what goes to disk — with no nest in it](shots/build-nest-not-in-the-file.png)

**The sixth pass mounted the realm's own bar over Build so that all seven words could be saved there. It worked — and the bar brought the drawer with it.** The drawer is written for a page that **is** seven words. Neither editor is one, and now three of its boxes say things that are not true:

- **The nest control writes nothing.** Clicking a nest chip in Build puts a whole dashboard in the box; the file pane — whose own line reads *"the node exactly as it goes to disk; it changes with every control you press"* — never gains a `nest`. **One press of Add a tab and the page inside is gone**, with nothing said. `build/stage.js:51` builds its stage without `nest`; `build/page.js:377` sets `keep` and no `keep_nest`. Both twins already exist in `make/page.js`.
- **The link box promises what it cannot keep.** I set *room = Wide* and *type size = Display* from Build's bar; the drawer handed me `…/build/?room=wide&type-size=display` under *"Open it cold, in any browser, and you get exactly this page."* Opened cold it gives **reading** and **regular** — Build's stage is `inner`, so it never reads the address.
- **Two files, two code blocks, two Save buttons, on one screen.** The drawer's *This page, as a file* prints the seven words **with** the nest and **without** the blocks or the children; thirty pixels below, the column's *The file* prints the same page **with** them and **without** the nest. Neither is the page you built. The drawer's *The same page, as code* prints a page titled **Build** — the page you are standing on. And on `make/notes/`, a real page with two children, that box prints a `page.js` with no `pages:` and no `children:` — a file that would draw the four canned strangers instead of Today and Later.

**That is five rounds of the same shape.** The seven words, then the blocks, then a nested page's children, then the eighth field on a saved page, and now the drawer itself. **Each pass fixed the level it was shown and moved the same control one level further in without asking what it was standing on.**

**What the realm IS now, in three sentences.** It is one box and eight words — seven that say what a page looks and behaves like, and an eighth that puts a whole other page inside it — drawn by one class, so a demo, a ready-made page and a page you save are the same machinery. You can set those words from a bar over any page, send what you set as a link, and on a page you made the bar writes them into a real `page.json` that survives a reload. **The one biggest thing left is that the builder wears that bar without being what the bar is for**: everything its drawer offers — a page inside this one, a link to what you are looking at, this page as a file, this page as code — is written for a page that is only seven words, so in the builder it saves nothing, links to nothing, and prints a file that is not the page you are building.

**Five items, ranked, in the `log` lines below** — one M, four S. Nothing above item 5 is cosmetic. Nothing under `public/` was changed by me; `public/imagine/paging` is clean apart from two `made/` pages Critic A wrote while I was probing.
